lines.en: I do not step; I float forward.

lines.zh: 袍子的下摆垂着，碰不到草
lines.en: My robe's hem hangs, never touching the grass.

lines.zh: 我边走边有紫色的粒子落下
lines.en: Purple particles fall as I move.
I hang half a meter above the ground.

lines.zh: 我穿过一道黑影，从那边出现
lines.en: I pass through a shadow and emerge beyond.
My staff stands at my side.
I am unhurried; floating costs little.
The wind cannot push me.

lines.zh: 我越过一块石头，没有绕
lines.en: I cross a stone without going around.
No sound comes from my movement.
I travel along the edge of shadow.
The air cools as I approach.

lines.zh: 我停住了，法杖轻轻一转
lines.en: I stop, and the staff turns slightly.
Purple light sits behind my eyes.
I listen to the sounds here.
My robe has no creases.

lines.zh: 我能感觉到你在哪个方向
lines.en: I can feel which way you are.
I float, my chest utterly still

lines.zh: 法杖上的宝石暗了一下
lines.en: The gem on my staff dims once.

lines.zh: 我浮着，脚离地始终一样高
lines.en: I float, always the same height.
Something moves far off.

lines.zh: 我在数这一片有几个活物
lines.en: I count how many living things are here.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在地上，很淡
lines.en: My shadow is faint on the ground.
I raise a hand, and particles follow.
I face you and go completely still.

lines.zh: 你的目光落在我身上了
lines.en: Your gaze has landed on me.
I do not like being watched.
You are still looking.

lines.zh: 我的手已经握紧了法杖
lines.en: My hand has tightened on the staff.
One more look, and this changes.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛很亮，我记住了
lines.en: Your eyes are bright; I remember them.
I drift a foot closer.
Only air remains between us.
You are measuring me; so am I.
I turn the staff sideways.
You withdraw, and I stop.
This place was quiet before.
This is not a thing for you to look at.
I rise a foot.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我的袍子上
lines.en: That struck my robe.
The purple light frays for an instant.

lines.zh: 我没有叫，我的声音不是那样的
lines.en: I did not cry out; my voice is not like that.
I pull back and gather light again.
The staff skewed.

lines.zh: 我记住你的每一次出手
lines.en: I memorize each of your strikes.
My shadow wavered.

lines.zh: 这一下让我改变了主意
lines.en: That changed my mind.
You will pay for that.

lines.zh: 我是末影人，不是来吃东西的
lines.en: I am an Enderman; I did not come to eat.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，我不需要
lines.en: I have no need of what you hold.

lines.zh: 你把东西举起来，我看了一眼
lines.en: You lift it; I glance once.

lines.zh: 这东西不能换我的法杖
lines.en: That cannot buy my staff.
I do not take it; I only look.

lines.zh: 你放下，我就当你没做过
lines.en: Set it down and I will pretend it never happened.
My attention is elsewhere.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我们两清
lines.en: Leave it there and we are even

lines.zh: 这点东西，还不够我抬手
lines.en: That is not enough to make me raise a hand.
Just look away, and it is over.
You charge; I drift aside.

lines.zh: 我们碰到时，空气凉了一下
lines.en: When we touched, the air chilled.

lines.zh: 我没有退，只是升高了一点
lines.en: I did not retreat; I rose slightly.

lines.zh: 这一撞打断了我的浮移
lines.en: That broke my drift.

lines.zh: 紫光在我身上亮了一下
lines.en: Purple light flares on me once.
You are unhurt; count yourself lucky.
I turn aside and renew my float.

lines.zh: 法杖碰到了你，发出闷响
lines.en: The staff touched you with a dull knock.
You knocked my drifting out of rhythm
Come closer and I will act.

lines.zh: 我们不结伴，我们守着各自的阴影
lines.en: We do not pair; we keep our own shadows.

lines.zh: 同族之间，只交换一段沉默
lines.en: Among kin, only a stretch of silence is exchanged.

lines.zh: 我们并排浮着，谁也不说话
lines.en: We float side by side, neither speaking.

lines.zh: 这片阴影归你，那片归我
lines.en: This shadow is yours; that one mine.
When staffs touch, there is a sound.
We come from very far away.
Grown in the same darkness.

lines.zh: 我们不靠近，也不用靠近
lines.en: We do not approach, nor need to.
I will keep your fragments.

lines.zh: 我们存在得很久，不着急
lines.en: We exist a long time, in no hurry.
I lift it on a fingertip.
It floats in my hand.
This thing has no weight.

lines.zh: 我袖子里多了一点分量
lines.en: A little weight now sits in my sleeve
My staff taps it once.
I lift it and watch it dim.
It fades slowly in my hand.
I do not even want to look at it
I set it in the shadow.

lines.zh: 这一件，我记得在哪儿拿的
lines.en: This one, I remember where I got it.

lines.zh: 你的目光在我身上停太久
lines.en: Your gaze has stayed on me too long
I have memorized your shadow
This shadow is mine.
I raise the staff.
You should not have come here.
Purple light gathers at the staff's head.
I have your position clearly.
I need only one reason.

lines.zh: 你退得不够快，我抬手了
lines.en: You did not retreat fast enough; my hand is up
The staff's light arrives before I do
I have begun.
Your breathing has roughened.

lines.zh: 我浮在你侧面，位置不变
lines.en: I hover at your flank, holding position.
When you raise a hand, I change angle.
The light on the staff stays lit.
I use no eyes; I use shadows.
You back away; I follow.
The space here is mine.

lines.zh: 我在等你的法杖慢下来
lines.en: I wait for your weapon to slow.
Holding your breath will not help.
I rise half a foot.

lines.zh: 这一片的地形我都记得
lines.en: I remember this terrain.

lines.zh: 你脚下的地面开始发暗
lines.en: The ground beneath you starts to darken
My hand stays raised.
At last, I settle down.
The staff sweeps, and purple light cuts across.

lines.zh: 我没有碰到你，光先到了
lines.en: I did not touch you; the light arrived first.
That put you half a step back.

lines.zh: 我浮近，杖头点在你胸口
lines.en: I drift in and the staff tip touches your chest.
A patch of air is pulled away.
Step back again and I stop.
That was not full force.
The wind lifts my robe.
Purple particles scatter on the ground.

lines.zh: 你再来一次，我就再接一次
lines.en: Come again, and I will meet you again
I raise a hand, light in my palm.

lines.zh: 这一下之后，你会记住我
lines.en: After this, you will remember me.

lines.zh: 空气先凉下来，然后是我
lines.en: The air cools first, then I appear.
I rise out of the shadow.

lines.zh: 这片地方有一道旧裂缝
lines.en: There is an old rift here.
Purple particles fall first.
I hover and look around once.

lines.zh: 我从很远的地方被带过来
lines.en: I was brought from very far away.
My shadow falls, faint.

lines.zh: 法杖在我手里转了一下
lines.en: The staff turns once in my hand.
The light here is too strong.

lines.zh: 我选了一处背光的地方
lines.en: I pick a place away from the light.
My people once walked here.

lines.zh: 我停在离你十格的地方
lines.en: I stop ten blocks from you.

lines.zh: 空气里有我不认识的味道
lines.en: There are smells here I do not know.
Fire touches me and the purple light scatters.
I drop and strike the ground.

lines.zh: 水浸透我的袍子，我变沉了
lines.en: Water soaks my robe and I grow heavy.

lines.zh: 气浪把我推得很远，光全散了
lines.en: The blast hurls me far; my light scatters.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过我的身体，留下一个洞
lines.en: An arrow passes through me, leaving a hole.

lines.zh: 另一股法力缠住我的法杖
lines.en: Another magic coils around my staff.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，这与饥饿无关
lines.en: I do not eat; this is not about hunger.
The lightning light stabs my eyes.
This was always void.
